name: sdd
description: A spec-driven workflow with local-only milestone memory: /milestone clarifies the intended outcome and optionally syncs epic progress read-only from Beads; /specify authors stories/epics, /refine revises them, /board renders the backlog, /solve implements one in an isolated worktree, /validate merges after human review, and /orchestrate runs ordered story/epic targets behind one GitHub PR or GitLab MR, with explicit post-merge finalization for complete epics. Also ships code-review-quality and writing-claude-md.
author: nadiar <codex@nadiar.id>

interface.shortDescription: Track a milestone, then author, solve, validate, and orchestrate stories.
interface.longDescription: Clarify and keep local-only milestone memory in .milestone.md, optionally sync epic progress read-only from Beads, then manage the engineering workflow from story authoring through isolated implementation, human-reviewed merge, and ordered multi-story/multi-epic orchestration behind one GitHub PR or GitLab MR with explicit post-merge finalization. Ships all three marketplace plugins as one Kimi plugin.
